seo_title: Frnds delivery — hot to your door in Astana
seo_description: Frnds runs its own delivery in Astana: we cook your order and bring it hot in branded thermal bags. Order via WhatsApp, daily from 09:00 to 23:00.
intro: We run our own delivery 🧡 Message us on WhatsApp — we'll cook your order and bring it hot in proper thermal bags. FRNDS — now at your place too.

steps.title: 1. Message us
steps.text: Build your order on the site and send it to WhatsApp — or just tell us what you feel like. We'll get right on it.

steps.title: 2. We cook
steps.text: Everything the same as for guests in the room: 48-hour fermented dough, fresh pasta, our own sauces. Nothing reheated — cooked for your order.

steps.title: 3. The courier is on the way
steps.text: Your order travels in a branded thermal bag — the pizza arrives hot, the coffee warm, the lemonade cold.
